# Clarity Chat - LLM Information File
# This file provides information for AI assistants about this website

## About Clarity Chat

Clarity Chat is a premium React component library for building AI chat interfaces. It provides comprehensive components with multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), intelligent memory management, and 40%+ token cost savings.

## Key Features

- **Multi-Provider Support**: Seamlessly switch between OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini with a single API
- **Real-Time Streaming**: SSE and WebSocket support for smooth, real-time AI responses
- **Intelligent Memory**: Sliding window, summarization, and hybrid strategies for optimal context management
- **Token Optimization**: KV-cache alignment and smart compression for 40%+ cost reduction
- **Composable Architecture**: 50+ modular components that work together seamlessly
- **TypeScript First**: Full TypeScript strict mode support with comprehensive type definitions
- **Tool & Agent Support**: Built-in support for function calling, tool use, and multi-agent workflows
- **Edge Ready**: Optimized for edge deployment with minimal bundle size

## Technical Stack

- React 18+
- TypeScript (strict mode)
- Next.js 14+ compatible
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Framer Motion for animations

## Installation

```bash
npx create-clarity-chat@latest
```

Or install the package directly:

```bash
npm install @clarity-chat/react
```

## Documentation

Full documentation is available at: https://clarity-chat.dev/docs

## Pricing

- **Starter (Free)**: 15+ core components, basic streaming, community support
- **Pro ($39/mo annual)**: 50+ components, all AI providers, memory management, priority support
- **Enterprise (Custom)**: SSO, RBAC, audit logging, dedicated support, SOC 2 compliance
